record.question: You may either go to the library or go out and play. Analyse the sentence and choose the correct option.
record.explanation: Answer C: Simple sentence. One subject and a coordinated pair of verb phrases (“go ... or go out and play”) form a simple sentence, not two independent clauses. Independent check: “Either … or” coordinates verb phrases under one subject (“you”); the sentence is simple, with coordinated predicates. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/conjunctions. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
